caption: The drawing features a single, round bowl centrally positioned on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The bowl has a wide opening, slightly flared rim, and a small, narrow base. Its exterior surface displays a decorative pattern of scalloped or arc-like indentations circling just below the rim. The coloration of the bowl includes assorted shades of brown, ochre, tan, and touches of lighter and darker accents, giving the bowl a mottled, glazed appearance with variations in light reflection. There is a small, handwritten red stamp or signature reading “Chas F. Moss 33” located to the left of the bowl's base. There are no additional objects present, and the background remains plain and unembellished.
title: Bowl - Bennington
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
